purpose: Primary Fair Work Commission appeal ledger preserving alternative employment, post-dismissal client redirection, relationship breakdown, and a scheduled compensation remedy without treating scheduled instalments as receipt.

events.geography: Hervey Bay, Queensland, Australia; Fair Work Commission matter U2023/5979 and appeal C2024/1990
events.date_precision: employment end date; appeal decision issued 2024-06-24 and records alternative work and scheduled compensation
events.denominator: One publicly identified adjudicated worker case; no population denominator
events.method: Structured extraction from primary Full Bench appeal reasons and the underlying remedy record identified there
events.missingness: Worker identity beyond public case name, full offer set, payment execution, instalment receipt, later job duration, household effect, standardized trust, recurrence, and exit are not retained
events.exposure: The employer terminated an apprentice hairdresser after performance concerns and procedural failures that the Commission found unfair
events.alternatives_before_action: The worker obtained alternative employment at a surf shop and earned approximately $2,000 during the relevant period; the full opportunity set and whether alternatives were freely chosen are not reported
events.immediate_burden_or_benefit: The worker lost the salon role and the Commission estimated $13,066.28 in counterfactual earnings before deducting surf-shop earnings, notice pay, and other reductions
events.choice_or_response: Both parties indicated reinstatement was not sought because the relationship had broken down; the worker referred clients who approached her to her aunt's salon rather than doing hair at home
events.person_or_actor_with_control: Employer controlled dismissal and workplace relationship; worker controlled alternative work and client referrals; the Commission controlled compensation and instalment schedule
events.remedy_or_institutional_response: The Commission ordered $6,554.33 before tax in two instalments: $3,277.17 within 30 days and $3,277.16 within 60 days of the remedy decision
events.remedy_receipt: Instalment receipt is not observed at worker level
events.durability_followup: Alternative earnings and client redirection are observed; later work, recurrence, trust, and exit remain unknown
events.immediate_outcome: Alternative employment, post-dismissal client redirection, relationship breakdown, and a scheduled compensation remedy are observed; instalment receipt is not
events.protected_outcome: Alternative income and a formal compensation route partially protected economic continuity; original employment was not restored
events.sacrificed_outcome: The worker lost the apprenticeship and part of the counterfactual earnings; client continuity and longer-term career effects are not measured
events.cost_risk_transfer: The worker carried transition and relationship costs; the employer received a staged compensation obligation subject to execution
events.later_outcome: Alternative surf-shop earnings and client redirection are observed, but instalment receipt, later work, household recovery, trust, recurrence, switching, and exit remain unknown
events.meaning_and_attribution: The public record attributes non-return to relationship breakdown and shows client-redirection action; it is a case-level signal, not a standardized trust measure
events.public_or_collective_response: An individual application, remedy hearing, and appeal are observed; no later collective or political response is reported
events.counterexample: A worker can earn alternative income and redirect clients after dismissal while the original relationship remains unrepaired; a staged order is not receipt
events.source_and_uncertainty: Primary Fair Work Commission Full Bench decision [2024] FWCFB 293, https://www.fwc.gov.au/documents/decisionssigned/pdf/2024fwcfb293.pdf; the appeal reasons preserve the underlying order, alternative earnings, client-redirection evidence, and instalment schedule but no payment confirmation

arrows.evidence: The Full Bench records approximately $2,000 earned from alternative surf-shop employment after the July 2023 termination
arrows.counterexample: Alternative earnings do not establish equivalent work, full opportunity, or voluntary choice
arrows.remaining_gap: Job duration, hours, wage equivalence, offers, and constraints

arrows.evidence: Both parties did not wish to consider reinstatement; the worker testified she referred clients to her aunt rather than performing hair work at home
arrows.counterexample: Client redirection and non-return show a case-level response, not a population-level exit or standardized distrust measure
arrows.remaining_gap: Later client/work trajectory, trust, identity, and practical exit

arrows.from: alternative earnings and assessed counterfactual loss
arrows.evidence: The Full Bench records the $6,554.33 compensation order in two instalments with 30- and 60-day deadlines
arrows.counterexample: A staged order is not proof either instalment was paid or received
arrows.remaining_gap: Payment execution, receipt, tax, net recovery, and residual loss

arrows.to: later recovery, trust, recurrence, or exit
arrows.evidence: The public appeal record ends at the alternative earnings, client redirection, relationship breakdown, and scheduled remedy
arrows.counterexample: A post-dismissal action can coexist with unresolved income, trust, and career effects
arrows.remaining_gap: Receipt, later work, household recovery, durable trust, recurrence, switching, and exit

arrows.evidence: The appeal refused permission but reports no employer process correction, monitoring, or comparable-worker outcome
arrows.counterexample: A formal legal remedy can coexist with unchanged workplace practice
arrows.remaining_gap: Employer correction, recurrence, worker voice, monitoring, and future employment conditions

boundary: This ledger adds one primary adjudicated case with observed alternative earnings, client-redirection action, relationship breakdown, and a scheduled compensation remedy. It does not establish payment receipt, household recovery, standardized trust, recurrence, switching, or exit.
storage_boundary: No claimant file, direct identifier beyond public case references, bulk archive, or payment instrument is retained; only bounded primary appeal fields, dates, alternative work, action, remedy schedule, uncertainty, and open downstream arrows are represented.
